errorIssues.title: Agent will not load with the configured model
errorIssues.description: hephaestus requires GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, or GPT-5.6; configured anthropic/claude-opus-5. The agent is dropped from every session.
errorIssues.fix: Set agents.hephaestus.model to a supported model, or remove the override to use the default chain.

hephaestusDetailLine: ● hephaestus: anthropic/claude-opus-5 (medium) [capabilities: snapshot-backed] ✗ NOT LOADED (requires GPT-5.3 Codex, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, or GPT-5.6)
